title: Signed manifest envelope (schema version 1)
description: manifest.json, the only signed file. It is a single file so a cache can never serve a manifest and a signature from different deployments. To verify: (1) base64-decode `manifest` to the manifest bytes; (2) verify `signature` over exactly those bytes with the embedded Ed25519 public key named by `signingKeyId`; (3) only then parse the bytes as JSON and validate them against manifest.schema.json; (4) require the parsed signingKeyId to equal the envelope's. Never parse or trust the manifest bytes before the signature verifies.

signingKeyId.description: Selects which embedded public key verifies the signature.

manifest.description: The manifest bytes: canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of an object that satisfies manifest.schema.json, encoded as UTF-8 and then as base64. These decoded bytes are exactly what the signature covers.

signature.description: An Ed25519 (RFC 8032, pure) signature of the decoded manifest bytes: 64 bytes, base64-encoded, which is 88 characters.
